subject.title: chore(deps): bump astro from 7.0.6 to 7.1.0 in the npm_and_yarn group across 1 directory

question: Should the repository accept Astro 7.1.0 after a maintainer-run production-build and deployed-preview smoke, or defer this Dependabot update?
rationale: The automated checks are green and no patch defect is evident, but the required real behavior proof cannot be supplied by the Dependabot author and acceptance of a direct framework minor upgrade remains a repository-specific release decision.

options.title: Verify then merge
options.body: Run a fresh production build and smoke the deployed preview, attach redacted evidence, and merge if the normal site routes and content render correctly.

options.title: Defer the upgrade
options.body: Leave this dependency update open or close it in favor of a later Astro upgrade if current release timing makes the extra framework churn undesirable.

recommendation.title: Verify then merge
recommendation.body: Run a fresh production build and smoke the deployed preview, attach redacted evidence, and merge if the normal site routes and content render correctly.
